label: GST collections, total
description: Domestic GST collected in the month (CGST + SGST + IGST), by state
caveat: Provisional. Counted by the state where the taxpayer is registered, not where goods are consumed.

label: GST collections, CGST
description: Central GST collected in the month, by state
caveat: Provisional. Counted by the state where the taxpayer is registered.

label: GST collections, SGST
description: State GST collected in the month, by state
caveat: Provisional. Counted by the state where the taxpayer is registered.

label: GST collections, IGST
description: Integrated GST collected in the month, by state
caveat: Provisional. Counted by the state where the taxpayer is registered.

label: GSDP, current prices
description: Gross State Domestic Product at current prices, base 2011-12 (published in ₹ lakh)
caveat: Current prices include inflation; use constant prices for real growth. J&K includes Ladakh up to 2018-19.

label: GSDP, constant 2011-12 prices
description: Gross State Domestic Product at constant 2011-12 prices (published in ₹ lakh)

label: Per capita NSDP, current prices
description: Net State Domestic Product per person at current prices, base 2011-12
caveat: A ratio: never add or average across states. J&K includes Ladakh up to 2018-19.

label: Per capita NSDP, constant 2011-12 prices
description: Net State Domestic Product per person at constant 2011-12 prices
caveat: A ratio: never add or average across states. J&K includes Ladakh up to 2018-19.

label: Bank offices (scheduled commercial banks)
description: Offices of scheduled commercial banks as at end-March
caveat: From 2020 Dadra and Nagar Haveli includes Daman and Diu.

label: Bank deposits (scheduled commercial banks)
description: Deposits with scheduled commercial banks as at end-March
caveat: From 2020 Dadra and Nagar Haveli includes Daman and Diu.

label: Bank credit (scheduled commercial banks)
description: Credit by scheduled commercial banks as at end-March
caveat: From 2020 Dadra and Nagar Haveli includes Daman and Diu.

label: Population (projected)
description: Projected population on 1 July (published in thousands)
caveat: A projection made in 2019 from Census 2011, not a count.

label: Male population (projected)
description: Projected male population on 1 July (published in thousands)
caveat: A projection made in 2019 from Census 2011, not a count.

label: Female population (projected)
description: Projected female population on 1 July (published in thousands)
caveat: A projection made in 2019 from Census 2011, not a count.

label: Wireless (mobile) subscribers
description: Wireless (mobile) subscribers at month end, by licensed service area
caveat: By telecom service area, not state; some areas cover several states.
